plugins.name: 2D Video Editing Studio
plugins.description: Senior Video Editor & Autonomous 2D Production Engine (v3.5.0): 6 Official Styles (Vox/Box Paper, Stickman, Sticker, Noir, Hand-Drawn Doodle, Retro Arcade), Recipe-Driven Autopilot Edits, Voice-Synced Asset Placement, built-in DeepX Google Flow asset engine (login check → one Agent/Standard question → autopilot; Agent Mode ≤24 prompts per part back-to-back; automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks), Anti-Offline Server Shield, high-speed render presets and 15-minute timeline scaling.

plugins.name: Facebook Automation & SEO Studio
plugins.description: Pre-Trained Phone (Desktop-on-Phone www.facebook.com & Mobile Touch m.facebook.com) and Desktop Facebook Automation Engine (v1.8.0): Dedicated Feed Posts (Text/Photo/Carousel/Video), Anti-Comment Firewall (strictly never posts into comments), Reels (/reels/create + automatic mobile fallback + video event dispatch), Stories (/stories/create Photo/Video with overlay story_text & Text Story), Real Video/Reel Thumbnail & Cover Uploader, Multiline Formatted Caption Engine (Title + Description + Bullets + CTA + 3-6 #Hashtags), and Zero-Overthinking 1-Call Dispatch, and built-in DeepX Google Flow engine for AI thumbnails, Reel covers and post designs (login check → Agent/Standard question → autopilot, automatic Agent fallback on unusual-activity blocks).

plugins.name: Meta Suite Page Management
plugins.description: Master Autonomous Meta Suite Production Engine (v2.3.0): Enterprise Meta Business Suite Facebook Page management, auto-open Meta Business Suite on login, persistent bridge background thread, embedded multi-platform trend radar, 1-click publishing & scheduling of Page Reels, Long Videos, Photos, Stories with in-memory DataTransfer injection, synthetic clipboard paste, anti-ad organic shield, and Google Flow AI media generation.

plugins.name: DeepX Google Flow Studio
plugins.description: DeepX Google Flow Studio (v1.1.0): the complete DeepX Flow extension as an AntiGem MCP plugin — no side panel. Checks Google login, asks Agent Mode vs Standard mode before every generation; Agent Mode auto-splits big batches into ≤24-item parts pasted back-to-back with 100% autopilot approvals; Standard mode runs on AntiGem's native Flow engine and auto-switches to Agent Mode when Google shows an unusual-activity / extension block. Includes storyboard analyzer, characters, references, scene chaining, upscale, downloads and all deepx_* / flow_* tools.
